footer.description: Nzvimbo yekutanga yekuongorora zvematongerwo muKenya inoshandiswa neAI. Yakavakirwa sarudzo dza2027.

about.storyP1: Mishandirapamwe yekuKenya nhasi inomhanya nemanzwiro uye nekungofumidzira kubva kune vanopa mazano.
about.storyP2: Vanokunda nevanorasikirwa vanowanzosarudzwa nerombo rakanaka, kwete nehungwaru.
about.storyP4: Tiri kuvaka hurongwa umo sarudzo dzese dzezvematongerwo dzinotsigirwa nehuchenjeri chaihwo, hunogara huchienderera mberi. Kwete kufungidzira.
about.why1: Kunzvera kwechokwadi-nguva - kusati kwasarudzwa kuburikidza nevanoona nezvemamiriro ezvinhu
about.why3: Kubatsira kuri kuenderera mberi kubva kumushandirapamwe kuburikidza nekutonga
about.visionText: Vatungamiriri vanoita zvisarudzo zvichibva pahungwaru, kwete nemarombo.
about.p1Desc: Yakavakirwa chiSwahili neSheng kubva pazuva rekutanga. Haisi mienzaniso yeChirungu yakachinjaniswa kuEast Africa.
about.p2Desc: Dhata yevanokwikwidza haigone kugoverwa nevamwe. Mushandirapamwe wega wega unoona kungwara dzadzo dzavanoziva kuti ndedzinangoni here.
about.p3Desc: Mitengo yakagadzirirwa kuti munhu anenge achikwidza kuva MCA kekutanga agone kutenga zvinhu zvakafanana nezvakaitwa nemushandirapamwe wekuti ave gavhuna.
about.p4Desc: Tinenge tichida kupa nzwisiso imwe chete yakasimbiswa pane gumi dzine ruzha.

bios.morris: Kufambisa maonero nekukura kweKampeni. Kuvaka chikuva chekutanga chezvematongerwo muKenya chekuongorora kuti vatungamiriri vanoita sei zvisarudzo nenzira dzakasiyana siyana.
bios.barak: Kuvaka zvivakwa zvinoshandura midziyo inobudisa nhau yeKenya kuti iite zvekufambisa nekunzvera. Pakutanga yakavakira masisitimu ezvematongerwo eEast African fintechs.
bios.albert: Kugadzira chikuva chakakosha - kubva pamapayipi edata nemamodheru eNLP kuenda kudashibhodhi iro mishandirapamwe inotsamira pairi mangwanani oga wega.
bios.john: Kuongorora zano remari raKampeni uye kuona kuti chikuva ichi chinogara chichiyerera mumamiriro ezvematongerwo emu Kenya.
bios.anwar: Kutungamira nzira yezvematongerwo uye hukama nevatengi muKenya. Kufukidza mukaha uri pakati pezvinyorwa zvemasangano anoona nezvekufambiswa kwemasoja nemasarudzo chaiwo anoita mushandirapamwe uyu.

contact.eaDesc: Iva mumwe wevatungamiriri vekutanga vezvematongerwo muKenya kuti vawane mukana wekushandisa chikuva cheKampeneni. Nzvimbo shoma dziripo.
contact.partnerDesc: Masangano asingabatsiri masimba, mabhizimisi anoita zvekuvhota nemasangano enhau - ngationgororei zvatinogona kuvaka pamwe chete.
contact.footerTagline: Mwaka unotevera wesarudzo unotanga izvozvi. Ramba uchienda mberi.

features.headerSubtitle: Mamodheru mana ezvekuongorora anoshanda pamwe chete  kuitira kuti mushandirapamwe wako ugare uine ruzivo rwakanakisisa kudarika nemumwe munhu ari mumba.
features.ctaSubtitle: Kumbira kuwana nekukasira kana kuongorora nzvimbo yekuraramisa inenge iripo.
features.f1Sub: Ziva zvavanoda kuti vavhoti venyu vaite sezvazvinoitika
features.f1b1: Tarisa manzwiro anoita munhu pane zvemasocial media, nhau nemishumo inobva kumunda
features.f1b2: Ziva nyaya dziri kubuda dzichitanga kusangana nedambudziko risati rasvika
features.f2Sub: Ramba uri pamberi pekufambiswa kwese kweanokwikwidza
features.f2b1: Tarisa mashoko ose anotaurwa nevoruzhinji uye nekuratidzwa kwazvinoitwa munhau
features.f2b3: Gadzira mazano anokwikwidza akavakirwa pachokwadi mumaminetsi
features.f3Sub: Nzvimbo yekushandisa mari kuti uwane huwandu hwekuzadziswa kwevhoti
features.f4Sub: Utonge uine chivimbo uye urongere kusarudzwa kwako zvakare nekukasira
features.f4b2: Kuongorora nyaya dzevanhu vari muchikamu chehurumende vachishandisa WhatsApp neSMS
features.f4b3: Wana yambiro dzekutanga pamusoro pekudonha kwekutenderwa uye njodzi dzezvematongerwo

media.headerSubtitle: Zvese zvinodikanwa nevatapi venhau nevanoita basa rezvekufambiswa kwenhauro kuti vape nhau pamusoro peKampeni.
media.r1Desc: PNG, SVG, uye mavhoriyamu evatori mumhando dzakasiyana siyana dzemavara.
media.r2Desc: Mifananidzo ine resolution yepamusoro uye mifananidzo yechikwata kuti ishandiswe nevatevedzeri venhau.
media.r3Desc: Nzvimbo yekambani, tsananguro yezvigadzirwa uye nhungamiro dzechiratidzo.
media.quote: "Ramangwana rezvematongerwo muKenya ndevemakurukota vanoita zvisarudzo zvichibva pane zvavanoziva, kwete nekufungidzira kwakanaka."
